name: Fashion Island
description: Fashion Island is Orange County's premier open-air shopping destination, featuring world-class luxury retailers, upscale dining, and coastal sophistication in the heart of Newport Beach. With its stunning architecture and oceanside location, this lifestyle center offers an unparalleled shopping experience with premium brands, acclaimed restaurants, and a state-of-the-art movie theater.
demographics: Fashion Island attracts an affluent demographic with household incomes significantly above the national average, drawing from the surrounding coastal Orange County communities including Newport Beach, Corona del Mar, and Laguna Beach. The visitor base consists primarily of upper-income professionals, families, and retirees aged 35-65 who value premium brands and upscale dining experiences. The trade area is characterized by luxury homeowners and yacht club members who seek world-class shopping and entertainment in an open-air coastal setting, with shopping patterns emphasizing quality over value and a preference for experiential retail combined with fine dining.
summary: Orange County's premier open-air luxury lifestyle center offering world-class shopping, upscale dining, and coastal elegance in Newport Beach.
